title: rosa gallica var. incarnata
intro: Rosa gallica var. incarnata, commonly known as the Red Damask rose, is a fragrant and ornamental flowering plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Rosa gallica var. incarnata is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
